## Overview
To retrieve a subset of records from an individual CodeSystem, you will need to perform a 'POST' operation, in which you will provide the details of the CodeSystem you are searching, along with any filters to be applied and properties you wish to include in the results.

When you make a 'POST' operation, you perform an expansion on a ValueSet and provide a requestBody. The endpoint will return a successful (200) response code along with the search results, which may be an empty array

## Overview
Use this endpoint to get a single ValueSet for the specified ID.
